All three 8081 mentions are now 9090 — the health-check `curl`, the SEC-233 known issue, and the appendix table. Staging's 8091 is untouched, since you said the production port moved.

`verify.js` passes: all three edits landed and the rest of the document is intact.

One flag on the SEC-233 note: moving the port doesn't change the finding — 9090 is just as reachable from any pod as 8081 was. The known issue still reads correctly, but if the move *was* the mitigation, that ticket needs a real fix (auth or a network policy), not a renumbered port.
